meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: Claude 会调用 Centinela(QA) agent 执行安全审计：检查 OWASP Top 10、硬编码密钥和依赖 CVE，输出报告到 docs/reviews/，并给出通过或不通过的结论。
howto.when: 在发布前验证安全状况、改动涉及认证/授权或数据处理之后，或做周期性安全审查时触发；不指定范围时默认审计整个 src/ 目录。

say.note: 不指定范围时审计整个 src/ 目录

say.text: 审计一下 src/payments/ 的密钥和依赖漏洞

howto.what_en: Claude runs a security audit via the Centinela (QA) agent: it checks OWASP Top 10 items, scans for hardcoded secrets, and audits dependencies for CVEs, writing a report to docs/reviews/ and a verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers before a release, after changes touching auth or data handling, during periodic security reviews, or when adding new dependencies. Without a scope, all of src/ is audited.

say_en.note: Audits all of src/ by default
Limits the audit to those paths

say_en.text: Audit src/payments/ for secrets and dependency CVEs
